name: aiopsterm
description: Self-owned AI operations terminal shell with backend-owned runtime boundaries.

scripts.build: npm run audit:i18n && npm run audit:state-ownership && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.build:linux:appimage: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:codex && npm run build:cline-sidecar && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:linux: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:codex && npm run build:cline-sidecar && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:deb: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:codex && npm run build:cline-sidecar && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --linux deb --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:mac: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:codex && npm run build:cline-sidecar && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:mac:dir: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:codex && npm run build:cline-sidecar && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --mac --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:win: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:codex && npm run build:cline-sidecar && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:win:dir: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:codex && npm run build:cline-sidecar && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.sidecar.json
scripts.test: npm run audit:i18n && npm run audit:state-ownership && npm run native:ensure:node && vitest run
scripts.test:live:jumpserver: npm run native:ensure:node && vitest run tests/live-jumpserver-backend.test.ts
scripts.test:live:ssh: npm run native:ensure:node && vitest run tests/live-ssh-backend.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run native:ensure:electron && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:quick: npm run build && npm run native:ensure:electron && playwright test --grep @quick
scripts.test:live:k8s: npm run native:ensure:node && vitest run tests/live-k8s-backend.test.ts
scripts.test:live:k8s:pty: npm run native:ensure:node && vitest run tests/live-k8s-sandbox.test.ts
